# Alternative Investment Analyzer Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Wealth Management

## Overview

Use when analyzing alternative investments including private equity, hedge funds, real estate, private credit, and infrastructure for portfolio construction, due diligence, and performance monitoring.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [alternative-investment-analyzer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
alternative-investment-analyzer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@alternative-investment-analyzer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Conduct operational and investment due diligence on alternative fund managers
- Calculate PE/VC performance metrics: gross/net IRR, TVPI, DPI, RVPI
- Evaluate hedge fund strategy risk: drawdown, volatility, correlation, liquidity
- Assess real estate investment metrics: cap rate, cash-on-cash, IRR, equity multiple

## Industry Standards Applied

- **ILPA Principles**: Institutional Limited Partners Association best practices for PE
- **GIPS (Alternative Provisions)**: Performance reporting standards for alternative investments
- **SEC Form PF**: Private fund advisor reporting requirements
